snippet.title: Novastorm gameplay (PC Game, 1993)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Novastorm, Dos PC game produced by Fujitsu Interactive in 1993 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/novastorm/7973/
Playing first two stages of this original arcade flight shooter game.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
